# ForestField

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/vegetation/forest.h`](../../../src/logic/vegetation/forest.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

Host context variable (held as std::shared_ptr<ForestField>): forest cover 0..1 and stand from patch noise and the land's slope, on an 8 m lattice anchored to the world.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `params` | `const ForestParams` | seed, patch_size, coverage, edge, max_slope, slope_fade, slope_reach, stand_size |
| `generator` | `std::shared_ptr<const TerrainGenerator>` | (private) the heightfield the slope is measured on |
| `patches` | `FastNoise::SmartNode<>` | (private) FBm simplex, 4 octaves: the patch noise |
| `stands` | `FastNoise::SmartNode<>` | (private) FBm simplex, 2 octaves: the stand noise |
| `cover_low` | `float` | (private) patch noise where the forest starts (measured quantile) |
| `cover_high` | `float` | (private) ... and where it is thick |
| `stand_sorted` | `std::vector<float>` | (private) sorted samples of the stand noise, to make it uniform |

## Notes

The context variable is std::shared_ptr<ForestField>, insert_or_assign'ed by Forest in init. Thread safe (const queries). Read by CameraWalk and HerdSys.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: CameraWalk, Herds. Written by: Forest. Created by: Forest. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md) | system | Host | **read** | plan, tick | cover and stand of the nodes for the line; with it the walk waits until every chunk is planted; std::shared_ptr<ForestField> |
| [Forest](../systems/Forest.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init | insert_or_assign of the std::shared_ptr<ForestField> (cover and stands), read by CameraWalk and HerdSys |
| [Herds](../systems/Herds.md) | system | Host | **read** | init | Forest cover for the kinds' where (std::shared_ptr). |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[Forest](../systems/Forest.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkForest> in preinit (onChunkForestDestroyed), disconnects in finish.
  - Reads ./resources/forest/tautavel.forest.json (or `definition`) in init, and resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates the plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs info (stands, layers, species, patch size), a warning per species the library lacks, an error without a terrain generator or with a bad definition (the system then does nothing).
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
